name: OrendaBox Hotspot
description: Start a WiFi hotspot on your OrendaBox so nearby phones, tablets and laptops can discover the Box-specific HTTPS Orenda Home portal and open Box-hosted web apps, even without internet access. Choose the WiFi name and password, optionally share the Box internet connection, or release a WiFi uplink once Ethernet or mobile data keeps the Box online. The Box owns the access point and keeps management behind Edge Console sign-in.
